description: Ask a Nepternship member for a warm introduction or referral to the person they can connect the user with, for example an analyst at JPMorgan or an engineer at Google. Use this when the user says they want to be introduced, referred, connected or put in touch with a member they have seen in search_members, browse_directory or get_member. An optional note of up to 200 characters (school, year, what role they are after) can be included; confirm the person and the note with the user before calling. Fails with a clear message if the user is out of free requests or already has a request or connection with this member.

claim_code.description: The claim_code from sign_up or sign_in, if the account is not connected in this conversation

name: send_intro_request
title: Request a warm introduction
